### Primary Distributions

| Distribution | Description | Format | Direct Download |
|---|---|---|---|
| **mapping.db** | Complete unified database (all formats, indexed) | SQLite | [Download](https://github.com/dango-service/community-mapping/releases/download/${TAG}/mapping.db) |
| **comics.db** | Visual formats (manga, manhwa, manhua) | SQLite | [Download](https://github.com/dango-service/community-mapping/releases/download/${TAG}/comics.db) |
| **novels.db** | Light novels and web novels | SQLite | [Download](https://github.com/dango-service/community-mapping/releases/download/${TAG}/novels.db) |
| **mapping.lean.json** | Minimal dataset (IDs + volumes, no heavy synonyms) | JSON | [Download](https://github.com/dango-service/community-mapping/releases/download/${TAG}/mapping.lean.json) |
| **distributions-bundle.zip** | All SQLite databases, JSONs, and SQL dumps in one archive | Archive | [Download](https://github.com/dango-service/community-mapping/releases/download/${TAG}/distributions-bundle.zip) |
